dialogue.speaker: Ivo
dialogue.text: Dry blankets, clean bandages, and six coins. Someone expected the road to open again. I would hate to disappoint them.

events.label: The ferryman’s emergency purse supplies the next patrol

dialogue.speaker: Nera
dialogue.text: The ferryman pressed his emergency purse into my hand. Six coins. We’ll use them to bring his neighbors home.

events.label: The ferryman’s letter points the way

dialogue.speaker: Nera
dialogue.text: He left us a road to follow. We owe him more than a lamp in the window.

waves.label: Two skeletons enter from the eastern road on turn 5
A bone bow reaches the southern crossing on turn 7
